title: 第23章 夜色下的黑影第24章 小师弟你还有吗
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
“这个……”
苏凡憨憨一笑，问道：“如果我说拿了，你会不会揍我？”
“你还真拿了？”
冷月眉毛一挑，怒道：“说，藏在哪？”
“没有没有。”
苏凡连忙摆手，干笑道：“我就是想看下大师姐的态度，会不会跟我同流合污……呸呸呸，什么话，怎么能叫同流合污？看我这臭嘴，真不会说话……”
“行了。”
冷月没好气的瞪了眼他，说道：“只要没拿就行，要不然就算师尊出面，也保不住你。”
看着在她面前唯唯是诺的苏凡，冷月叹了口气，道：“也怪我，没提前告诉你，西山不能去。”
“西山？”
苏凡问。
“西山就是那酒窖的所在地。”
“宗门的老人都知道，西山是狄老的地盘，不能随便踏足。”
“狄老这人，也没什么其它的好爱，就喜欢酿酒，喝酒。”
“并且他酿造出来的酒，味道极佳，很受宗门大佬的欢迎。”
“据说一坛，可以卖到一万灵石，所以这些酒，都是狄老的命·根子。”
“这次，李有德算是闯了大祸，等狄老找到他，就算不死，也得脱层皮。”
“以后，你少跟这种人来往。”
冷月叮嘱一句，转身离去。
一坛酒，就可以卖到一万灵石？

那一百三十坛，岂不就是一百三十万？
简直离谱。
苏凡追上去，低声笑问：“大师姐，那气血珠好用吗？”
“气血珠？”
冷月愣了下。
想起了苏凡给她的那些血珠，原来叫气血珠。
略作沉吟，她点了点头，便径直离去。
苏凡送走冷月，瞧着聚集在外面的弟子，得意洋洋的笑道：“想看我这个废灵体被狄老揍？可惜，小爷天生命好，让你们失望了。”
“天生命好能是废灵体？”
“可恶的小子，真想揍他。”
大家恶狠狠的瞪着苏凡。
“废灵体也比你们强，就问你们气不气？”
苏凡哈哈一笑，嘭地一声合上石门，拍着胸脯子，满脸后怕，总算躲过了这一劫。
大黑狗睁开眼，鄙夷道：“瞧你在冷月面前那傻样，真丢人。”
“要你管？”
苏凡揉着痛疼的小肚子，这老家伙力道可真大，一脚差点把他的内脏给震碎了。
不过好在是逢凶化吉了。
content_en:
"This..."
Su Fan smiled naively and asked, "If I say take it, will you beat me?"
"Did you really take it?"
Leng Yue raised her eyebrows and said angrily: "Tell me, where are you hiding?"
"No, no."
Su Fan waved his hands quickly and said with a smile: "I just want to see the attitude of senior sister, whether she will be complicit with me... Bah, bah, bah, what are you talking about? How can you call me complicit? Look at my bad mouth, I really can't speak..."
"Okay."
Leng Yue glared at him angrily and said, "As long as you don't take it, it's fine, otherwise even if Master comes forward, I won't be able to protect you."
Looking at Su Fan who was submissive in front of her, Leng Yue sighed and said, "It's my fault for not telling you in advance that you can't go to Xishan."
"Xishan?"
Su Fan asked.
"West Mountain is where the wine cellar is."
"All the elders in the sect know that Xishan is Mr. Di's territory and cannot be set foot casually."
"Mr. Di doesn't have much other hobbies. He just likes to make wine and drink wine."
"And the wine he brews has excellent taste and is very popular among the sect bosses."
"It is said that one jar can be sold for ten thousand spiritual stones, so these wines are the lifeblood of Mr. Di."
"This time, Li Youde is in big trouble. When Mr. Di finds him, even if he doesn't die, he will still have to shed his skin."
"In the future, you should avoid associating with such people."
Leng Yue warned, turned and left.
A jar of wine can be sold for 10,000 spirit stones?
Isn't that one hundred and thirty thousand altars equivalent to one million and three hundred thousand?
Simply outrageous.
Su Fan caught up and asked with a low smile: "Senior Sister, are those Qi and Blood Beads useful?"
"Qi and blood beads?"
Leng Yue was stunned for a moment.
She remembered the blood beads Su Fan gave her, which turned out to be Qi Blood Beads.
After pondering for a moment, she nodded and left.
Su Fan sent Leng Yue away, looked at the disciples gathered outside, and said with a triumphant smile: "Want to see me, a useless spirit body, beaten by Mr. Di? It's a pity that I have a good life, so I disappoint you."
"How can a natural being be a waste spirit?"
"Damn boy, I really want to beat him."
Everyone stared at Su Fan fiercely.
"The useless spirit body is stronger than you, so I'm asking if you are angry?"
Su Fan laughed, closed the stone door with a bang, patted his chest, his face was full of fear, and he finally escaped this disaster.
The big black dog opened his eyes and said scornfully: "Look at how stupid you are in front of Leng Yue. It's so embarrassing."
"I want you to take care of it?"
Su Fan rubbed his painful belly. This old guy was so strong that his internal organs were almost shattered with one kick.
But fortunately, the danger turned into good fortune.
